cutouts: Fusion cut-out SVG: Cut-outs trace each connector’s visible outline, not the manufacturer’s recommended panel cut-out with clearance and tolerance.

IR window / ON / OFF / AUTO-3S buttons: this catalog has no plain circular pushbutton part — modelled as unlit LEDs sized to match the drawing's circles; real part is almost certainly a physical button, not an LED.

TX badge: drawing shows only a boxed "TX", no PureLink wordmark — modelled as plain text, not the standard logo lockup, to avoid adding branding not present in the source drawing. Confirm with the user/supplier whether the real product carries PureLink branding elsewhere.

AV-USB3 OUT 1 (rear): drawing shows this RJ45 on a solid white background box; the tool's RJ45 colour-box is fixed magenta (built for HDBaseT), so this was approximated as an untitled white frame outline (not filled) instead.
Small icon beneath the front-panel power symbol (TX badge area) was not reproduced — its function could not be determined from the drawing.

DIP switches (IN1-4/AUTO selector x2): the drawing labels each of the 5 switch positions individually (IN1/IN2/IN3/IN4/AUTO) stacked vertically; this tool's pin-label system is disabled for DIP-type parts, so a single compact "IN1-4 / AUTO" text label was placed above each switch instead of 5 separate position labels.

The hex/washer icons above IN3/IN4/OUT1/OUT2 and the ring icons above USB-C IN1/IN2/HOST3 are this connector's own locking-screw insert ("lock": true on the hdmi/usbc item itself), not a separate ground screw or LED — corrected after initially misreading them as separate parts.

Chassis height raised from the drawing's literal 23mm to 30mm (a standard housing tier whose guide width range, 210–400mm, actually fits this 320mm-wide panel, unlike 23mm's 50–209mm): at 23mm there was no position for several connectors' own lock-hole insert, the OUT1/OUT2 and USB DEVICES group frames, and their labels that didn't force a tradeoff against the 3mm edge-clearance rule or a neighbour — done on the user's instruction.
USB-A, USB-C, HDMI, RJ45, Phoenix terminal blocks (GPIO/RS-232/RS-232 CTL/AUDIO IN/OUT): estimated from supplier silkscreen drawing V1.0, not signed off.
silkscreen: Silkscreen SVG: replicated from supplier drawing HDP-HUB42U40 Silkscreen_V1.0 (2026-08-28). This product's silkscreen ink is white only (no secondary Pantone colour per the drawing's own title block) — the rear AV-USB3 port's white highlight box could not be reproduced exactly (see cutouts notes).
Rear panel view in the source drawing is rotated 180°; corrected by re-measuring on a 180°-rotated copy of the crop rather than by formula, per this skill's own guidance.
Checked against the app's Checks panel: 0 problems, 0 warnings at 30mm chassis height.

Row-alignment (rules.alignLabels) turned off for this product: with it on, moving any one "below"-positioned label to clear a lock-hole conflict snapped every other below-label within 4mm onto the same line, repeatedly pushing unrelated labels off the panel edge. Each label sits at its own natural height instead.
